purpose: freeze exact Stage B fitting identity and select the fastest safe real-data executor

execution_identity.authority: master specification version 2.4 Phase 02 Stage B execution-identity and checkpoint contract
execution_identity.model_seed: unsigned first 32 SHA-256 bits of phase02 registration SHA, work-unit ID, exact candidate-cell ID, and stage_b_model_seed_v1
execution_identity.minibatch_order: NumPy PCG64 deterministic epoch permutations with exact registered batch size and wrap into the next epoch
execution_identity.initialization: independent SHA-256-derived Glorot-uniform kernels and zero biases
execution_identity.gru_input: paired training-standardized level and availability channels in oldest-to-current order; constant current availability is standardized zero
execution_identity.adamw: beta1=0.9; beta2=0.999; epsilon=float32 epsilon; no bias correction; kernel-only weight decay=1/sqrt(train rows)
execution_identity.sgd_nesterov: momentum=0.9; same kernel-only weight decay=1/sqrt(train rows)
execution_identity.elastic_net: float32 full-batch proximal accelerated gradient; unpenalized intercept; registered covariance Lipschitz step
execution_identity.learning_curve_cadence: max(1,B/16) updates for nonlinear; eight-update convergence cadence for linear
execution_identity.checkpoint_order: higher full inner raw PR-AUC, lower finite Brier, earlier update
execution_identity.plateau: B/4 registered updates without a strictly better checkpoint
execution_identity.recovery: nonlinear and elastic-net B to at most 2B; registered boundary linear to at most 16B
execution_identity.prediction_artifact: float32 prediction for every exact inner-validation row plus exact global row indices
execution_identity.publication: atomic candidate artifacts, shard-local append-only ledgers, verified exact merge and hash-checked resume

systems_backtest.selection_method: coverage minima chosen by stable candidate SHA-256 over protocol, feature form, history region/extremes, feature/train-row extremes, every family, both boundary directions, elastic-net L1/regularization axes, and every MLP/GRU width/depth/activation/dropout/optimizer/learning-rate/batch axis; plus the maximum registered GRU sequence depth
systems_backtest.topology_matrix: complete Cartesian product of registered CPU preparation workers and MLX stream lanes

resource_gates.mlx_memory_limit: device maximum recommended working set size
resource_gates.mlx_cache_limit: one eighth of physical unified memory

selection_rule.eligibility: all equivalence, determinism, resume, coverage, memory, swap, thermal, performance, power, and utilization gates pass
selection_rule.primary: highest median end-to-end candidate cells per second over three repetitions
selection_rule.plateau: among eligible configurations within three percent of the absolute fastest median, choose fewer MLX lanes, then fewer CPU preparation workers, then stable topology ID

research_basis: local taskpolicy(8) manual: -b is Darwin background priority and is forbidden
